Quote: A sense of purpose grows when you stay active, connected, and engaged in things that make life worth living.
Author: Héctor García & Francesc Miralles

Quote: Stop hiding from the evidence of what you are capable of surviving.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: Deliberately doing hard things can train you to keep going when comfort tells you to stop.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: Your past can explain you without giving you permission to remain unchanged.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: Accountability starts when excuses stop receiving special treatment.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: Keep proof of the hard things you have already done for the days when self-doubt returns.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: The first mental urge to quit may arrive before your real limit. Learn to question it instead of obeying it automatically.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: Mental toughness grows through repeated evidence that you can do difficult things.
Author: David Goggins

Quote: Begin with one completed task and let order create momentum.
Author: William H. McRaven

Quote: Small disciplines can steady you when the larger day becomes chaotic.
Author: William H. McRaven

Quote: Do not judge people before you have seen what they can endure or contribute.
Author: William H. McRaven

Quote: Some challenges require help from other people. Strength includes knowing when to rely on a team.
Author: William H. McRaven

Quote: Failure can become training when you return with more discipline.
Author: William H. McRaven

Quote: Hope sometimes means continuing the work before the outcome is visible.
Author: William H. McRaven

Quote: Improve the small area you can control and carry that standard into the next one.
Author: William H. McRaven
